worlds.label: 1984↔2029 closed war timeline
worlds.description: John's existence bootstrapped; Judgment Day tone inevitable

events.label: Skynet sends T-800 to kill Sarah Connor
events.description: In a future ruled by killer machines, the machine network sends a ruthless cyborg assassin back to 1984. Its target: an ordinary young woman named Sarah Connor, before her child is even born.

events.label: Resistance (John) sends Kyle Reese
events.description: The human resistance sends one of its own soldiers, Kyle Reese, back through time after the cyborg. His mission is simply to keep Sarah alive.

events.label: Naked cyborg and Reese arrive 1984 LA
events.description: Both travellers land in 1984 Los Angeles. The cyborg arrives naked, unharmed and unstoppable; the soldier arrives naked, human and with almost nothing to work with.

events.label: Phone-book hunt; Sarah targeted
events.description: The cyborg works down a phone book, killing every Sarah Connor in the city one by one. The real Sarah realises too late that she is being hunted.

events.label: Reese rescues Sarah; explains Judgment Day 1997
events.description: Kyle snatches Sarah from the killer's grip and tells her the impossible truth: a machine uprising will one day devastate the world, and her unborn son will lead what's left of humanity.

events.label: Reese and Sarah conceive John Connor
events.description: Hunted and running for their lives, Sarah and Kyle spend one night together in hiding - and that night is when her son, the future leader of humanity, is conceived.

events.label: Factory climax: Reese dies; T-800 crushed
events.description: In a robot factory the two men fight to the end: Kyle is killed in the explosion and the cyborg is torn apart - though the machine's torso still crawls after Sarah.

events.label: Arm/CPU left behind (Cyberdyne seed in sequels)
events.description: Amid the wreckage are the cyborg's crushed arm and computer brain. Instead of being destroyed, they are collected and studied - the very research that one day builds the machines.

events.label: Pregnant Sarah drives toward storm; records tapes for John
events.description: Alone and pregnant, Sarah drives through the desert recording tape messages of advice and warning for the son she will raise to be a soldier.

events.label: John's leadership depends on Reese whom John sent
events.description: Sarah's son only becomes a leader because Kyle trained and loved her - and Kyle was sent back by that very son. The story closes on itself.

events.label: T-800 and Reese arrive 1984
events.description: The killer cyborg and its human pursuer both arrive in 1984, seconds apart in the same city, and the hunt begins.

events.label: John conceived — paternal bootstrap
events.description: The child who grows up to send his own protector back through time is conceived during that rescue - his father came from the future to save his mother.

events.label: Factory destruction; Reese dies
events.description: The last battle happens in a factory: Kyle dies destroying the cyborg, and Sarah finishes the job by crushing what is left of it.

events.label: T-800 arrives 1984 to kill Sarah
events.description: The cyborg assassin lands in 1984 with one instruction: kill Sarah Connor so that her future son is never born.

events.label: Kyle Reese sent to protect Sarah
events.description: Kyle Reese volunteers to travel back and guard Sarah, knowing the man who sent him is the child he is protecting.

events.label: Police station massacre / chase
events.description: Sarah runs to the police, but the cyborg drives a car straight through the wall and kills nearly every officer in the building - so Kyle has to spring her from the chaos.

events.label: Kyle tells Sarah of future war
events.description: In a motel hideout, Kyle paints Sarah a picture of the future: cities in ruins, machines hunting people, and her son leading the survivors from broadcasts made after the war.

events.label: John Connor conceived (bootstrap)
events.description: During their one night of shelter, Sarah and Kyle conceive her son - a child whose father and protector came from the future for this exact purpose.

events.label: Kyle dies fighting T-800
events.description: Kyle blows up the cyborg with a truckload of explosives and dies in the blast, dying the way he always knew he would: protecting Sarah.

events.label: Sarah crushes T-800 in press
events.description: The shattered cyborg's torso still crawls after Sarah; she lures it into a giant factory press and crushes it flat.

events.label: Polaroid photo Kyle carried — origin loop
events.description: Kyle has carried a photograph of Sarah through the whole future war - she gave it to him long after this night, because this night is when he first told her about it.

events.label: Sarah drives toward storm / future
events.description: Battered but tougher, Sarah drives toward dark clouds gathering on the horizon, towards the war she now knows is coming.

ruleEffects.effect: John Connor has no origin outside the loop that sends his father
Skynet's attempt to erase John produces the conditions of his birth
1984 events close consistently with the 2029 war that sent the travelers

outcome.summary: Closed bootstrap: Reese sent by John fathers John; T-800 fails to erase Sarah; future war tone remains inevitable (contrast T2 mutability).
